description: Native SOL escrow for Lattice agent commerce, on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32.1). create_escrow and release_escrow were verified end-to-end: 1_000_000 lamports were locked in a program-owned PDA; the agent received 985_075 and the lattice wallet a 14_925 fee (amount/67). Rent remains in the PDA. A release signed by anyone else is rejected.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of TheWildJuan/lattice-escrow. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/lattice-escrow. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program and pointed the Anchor.toml wallet at the local CLI keypair. The hosted IDL is the lab build of the upstream IDL, confirmed by the verifying transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (create_escrow, release_escrow)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/lattice-escrow/
QA: devnet proof of create_escrow, release_escrow, and Unauthorized rejection
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Return remaining rent to the payer after release or refund
